UserObject.plantUmlData:
{
  "data": "@startuml
autonumber
title Sequence Diagram - Registrasi & Login
actor Pengguna
boundary "Halaman UI" as UI
control "Sistem (PHP)" as System
database "Tabel users" as DB

== Proses Registrasi ==
Pengguna -> UI : Input Data Registrasi
UI -> System : Kirim Data
System -> DB : Cek Email Unik
alt Email Sudah Ada
    System --> UI : Tampilkan Error "Email Terdaftar"
else Email Belum Ada
    System -> DB : Insert Data Pengguna Baru
    System --> UI : Registrasi Berhasil
end

== Proses Login ==
Pengguna -> UI : Input Email & Password
UI -> System : Request Login
System -> DB : Select User by Email
DB --> System : Return Data User & Password Hash
System -> System : Verifikasi Password

alt Login Valid
    alt Role == Admin
        System --> UI : Redirect Dashboard Admin
    else Role == Pelanggan
        System --> UI : Redirect Dashboard Pelanggan
    end
else Login Tidak Valid
    System --> UI : Pesan Error "Kredensial Salah"
end
@enduml",
  "config": null
}

UserObject.plantUmlData:
{
  "data": "@startuml
autonumber
title Sequence Diagram - Reservasi
actor Pelanggan
boundary "Halaman Reservasi" as UI
control "Sistem (PHP)" as System
database "Tabel lapangan & reservasi" as DB

Pelanggan -> UI : Input Tanggal, Jam, dan Lapangan
UI -> System : Cek Ketersediaan Jadwal
System -> DB : Query Cek Bentrok Jadwal (Tabel reservasi)
DB --> System : Hasil Pengecekan

alt Jadwal Bertabrakan
    System --> UI : Error "Jadwal Sudah Dipesan"
else Jadwal Tersedia
    System -> DB : Ambil Data Harga Lapangan (Tabel lapangan)
    DB --> System : Return Harga per Jam
    System -> System : Hitung Total Harga
    System -> DB : Insert Data Reservasi (Status = 'Belum Bayar')
    System --> UI : Reservasi Berhasil Dibuat
    UI --> Pelanggan : Tampilkan Halaman Tagihan
end
@enduml",
  "config": null
}

{
  "data": "@startuml
autonumber
title Sequence Diagram - Pembayaran
actor Pelanggan
boundary "Form Pembayaran" as UI
control "Sistem (PHP)" as System
database "Tabel pembayaran & reservasi" as DB

Pelanggan -> UI : Upload Bukti Bayar & Klik Kirim
UI -> System : Submit Form Pembayaran (File & Data)
System -> System : Validasi Format File
System -> System : Simpan File ke Folder Uploads
System -> DB : Insert Data ke Tabel pembayaran
System -> DB : Update Status Reservasi = 'Menunggu Validasi'
System --> UI : Upload Berhasil
UI --> Pelanggan : Tampilkan Status Menunggu Validasi
@enduml",
  "config": null
}

{
  "data": "@startuml
autonumber
title Sequence Diagram - Validasi Pembayaran
actor Admin
boundary "Halaman Admin" as UI
control "Sistem (PHP)" as System
database "DB (pembayaran & reservasi)" as DB

Admin -> UI : Buka Daftar Pembayaran Pending
UI -> System : Request Data Pembayaran
System -> DB : Select Data Pembayaran & Reservasi
DB --> System : Return Data
System --> UI : Tampilkan Daftar & Gambar Bukti Bayar

Admin -> UI : Cek Kesesuaian Bukti
alt Bukti Sesuai
    Admin -> UI : Klik "Konfirmasi"
    UI -> System : Request Approve
    System -> DB : Update Pembayaran = 'Lunas'
    System -> DB : Update Reservasi = 'Dikonfirmasi'
    System --> UI : Notifikasi Berhasil
else Bukti Tidak Sesuai
    Admin -> UI : Klik "Tolak"
    UI -> System : Request Reject
    System -> DB : Update Pembayaran = 'Ditolak'
    System -> DB : Update Reservasi = 'Ditolak'
    System --> UI : Notifikasi Ditolak
end
@enduml",
  "config": null
}
